headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.23
summary: This release fixes the 32-bit (armeabi-v7a) launch failure of v1.6.1-modder.21+ on AppCenter-using Minecraft builds: the launcher now ships a generated no-op maesdk stub, because libminecraftpe.so itself imports AppCenter C++ symbols directly and every available real arm32 maesdk binary is unusable against Google Play installs. Real-device testing on 32-bit phones still decides the next step, since the maintainer has no armeabi-v7a hardware.

items.text: 32-bit testers: please install the armeabi-v7a APK from this release and launch several times in a row. If a launch fails right after an app update, try once more and mention it — the first launch after an upgrade has its own flaky step we are still chasing.

Fixed 32-bit (armeabi-v7a) launches failing with "cannot locate symbol _ZTVN9Microsoft12Applications6Events16DebugEventSourceE" in libminecraftpe.so itself: the game library imports AppCenter C++ symbols directly (vtables are eager data relocations), so maesdk must load for minecraftpe to open at all — but neither available real arm32 maesdk binary works against a Google Play install (the game's own crashes in its static initializers, the MCPatch one mismatches the Play game's Java). The launcher now ships a generated no-op maesdk stub for 32-bit devices, built from the real maesdk's symbol surface, so minecraftpe's relocations resolve by soname match and telemetry becomes a no-op instead of fatal (issue #107).

Fixed a NullPointerException that crashed Instance Settings on open for every user on the stacked (non-two-pane) layout: the stacked page dropped the Management card's clear-cache section entirely, so the activity bound a missing button before the page ever rendered. The clear-cache card is back in the stacked design language, keeping the feature instead of just hiding the crash.

Made the AI crash-analysis result dialog usable on long answers: the result text no longer swallows vertical swipes so the content scrolls, and Markdown tables from the model now render as real tables instead of literal pipe characters (the model/provider picker lists already got the same scroll treatment).
